findings: DS-103 Rev 0 (SRC-EPCE-0004) LP admission 11.39 kg/s and LP exhaust 128.89 kg/s do not match HMB streams 13/14/16 (11.901 kg/s and 129.394 kg/s; HRSG DS-104 Rev B gives LP 11.90 kg/s and IP+RH 117.49 kg/s). Raise a TQ: DS-103 not updated after HRSG Rev A/B.

GT: DS-101 Rev A gives 425.0 MW at SRC-NG-100 (equipment 10MBA10 rated_power 425,000) but guarantee IG-03 is 418 MW at generator terminals; 425 x 98.9 % generator efficiency = 420.3 MW. Clarify whether 425 MW is shaft output and how IG-03 relates (margin 2.3 MW).

Condenser circulating water: DS-105 10,179 kg/s (36,050 m3/h) vs HMB stream 25/26 10,196.8 kg/s (0.2 % higher); duty 289.96 MW consistent with 7 K rise. CW pumps and intake are to be sized on the higher value.
HRSG design temperatures (HP SH, RH, IP, LP) are not stated in DS-104 Rev B, only design pressures; 605 degC entered from ST terminal design (IF-06/IF-10). Request from IEC (TQ).
HRSG duty and steam flows are consistent with HMB (RH 117.49 = HP 100.16 + IP 17.34 kg/s; IP feedwater 29.82 = 17.34 + 12.48 to the fuel gas heater).

Missing IEC items in the equipment list: HRSG condensate preheater recirculation pumps 2 x 100 % (DS-104 sec 2, aux_load AL-05), HP/IP/LP bypass valves and dump devices (DS-103 sec 1, supplied by IEC), generator neutral earthing transformers and generator protection panels (DS-102), excitation transformers, GT enclosure ventilation fans and fire suppression, HRSG drums / cyclone separators, ammonia skid pumps.
Stack (65 m, DP-CASE-0043) is EPC scope (IF-26, HRSG outlet 9.2 m diameter); no IEC stack tag exists, as expected. No stack damper included.
GSU losses: DS-106 1,110 / 580 kW vs aux_load AL-08 / AL-09 1,107 / 584 kW (differences below 1 %, acceptable but different sources).
Sizing of vacuum pumps 2 x 75 kW: aux_load AL-06 lists 75 kW for one running; hogging needs both pumps in parallel (150 kW) for 30 min at start-up; include in MV/LV start-up load case.
Condenser water-side design pressure and lube oil / vacuum pump capacities are not in the IEC datasheets; left out with VDRL remarks.
